title: TAP Boot Profile
description: A dev/debug boot profile: an ordered list of collectors to fire after seeding so a freshly-spawned stack comes up populated. Profile data files live in the top-level boot/ directory (filename is the profile id); this schema and its loader (the fire_boot_collectors management command) live in tap_cares. Spec: specs/spec-dev-boot-collectors.md (req-dev-boot-collectors-profiles).

description.description: Human label shown by `fire_boot_collectors --list` and in review.

on_failure.description: Behavior when a collector's job terminates FAILED. 'abort': stop, skip the rest, exit non-zero. 'continue': log and proceed; exit code still signals the failure.

collectors.description: Ordered list of collectors to fire. Fired sequentially in array order; each job is awaited to a terminal state before the next is fired.

key.description: The collector's qualified registry key (scope:key) exactly as stored in Collector.collector_registry, e.g. 'plugins.aws_core.collectors.boto3_collector.collector:boto3'. Resolved against the collector registry; an unknown key aborts the run before any collector fires.

enabled.description: false skips the entry without removing it (the 'comment it out' affordance).

run_mode.description: 'full' (default) runs self-test then collect; 'self_test_only' runs only the readiness probe.

note.description: Free-text annotation for the human reader (e.g. why an entry is ordered where it is).
